label: Work Visas
description: Temporary work visas for professionals, skilled workers, and specialty occupations in the United States.

label: Students & Exchange
description: Student visas and related work authorization for academic and vocational study in the U.S.

label: Visitor Visas
description: Short-term visas for tourism, business visits, and temporary stays without employment authorization.

label: Fiancé(e) & Family Nonimmigrant
description: Nonimmigrant visas for fiancés, spouses, and family members of U.S. citizens and residents.

label: Family Green Cards
description: Permanent residence through family sponsorship by U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents.

label: Employment Green Cards
description: Employment-based permanent residence for workers, professionals, and investors.

label: Humanitarian & Protection
description: Protection visas and humanitarian relief for those fleeing persecution or facing urgent circumstances.
